task.description: Hard gate on TEST-DESIGNER's output for REQ-418 (checkout feature/WF02-REQ418-20260927, pull to get commits c132c20d/4ece9556). Verify every one of REQ-418's 8 acceptance criteria has a runnable, correctly-targeted test: 5 pre-existing unit tests from ELIXIR-DEV (AC1, AC2, AC5, AC6, AC7) plus the 2 new live-Keycloak tests in test/letflow/integration/keycloak_mobile_client_auth_test.exs (AC3, AC4) -- cross-check test/specs/REQ-418.md's mapping against the actual test files rather than trusting the doc. Confirm the new file correctly follows the @moduletag :keycloak / async: false / setup_all-reachability convention from test/letflow/integration/keycloak_auth_pipeline_test.exs (no invented {:skip, ...} return, no new HTTP dependency). Confirm no coverage is skipped or stubbed out (e.g. no test that merely asserts the request 'doesn't crash' instead of the actual specified HTTP status/body/Location assertions). Confirm test isolation: does this new file depend on any state left behind by another test, or leave state that could affect a later test (check its own on_exit/cleanup, and whether the master-realm admin token acquisition could collide with keycloak_auth_pipeline_test.exs if both ran in the same --include keycloak invocation).
acceptance_criteria: Every one of REQ-418's 8 acceptance criteria maps to an actual, existing test (not a TODO/pending placeholder) -- verified by reading the test files, not just test/specs/REQ-418.md's claims
The new keycloak_mobile_client_auth_test.exs correctly uses @moduletag :keycloak, async: false, and the established RuntimeError-based reachability check (not {:skip, ...})
No new HTTP client dependency was added -- confirm via mix.exs diff

AC3's three sub-checks (valid request 200, evil redirect_uri rejected, missing code_challenge rejected) are each a distinct, specific assertion (status code AND body/Location content), not a vague 'succeeds'/'fails' check
AC4's admin evaluate-scopes check asserts both aud contains letflow-web AND azp == letflow-mobile as two distinct assertions
Test isolation confirmed: no shared mutable state risk with keycloak_auth_pipeline_test.exs or other :keycloak-tagged tests
PASS or FAIL with issues if FAIL; handoff completed per protocol (claim via IN_PROGRESS, then COMPLETED with a real result block)
